name: Protopasta PCTG
filament_notes:
Clear PCTG.
Product page: start from a Generic PETG or PCTG profile; 255C and up (they print up to 275C; 255C is a good compromise), 80C+ bed, about 2 mm3/s; reduce flow below 100% if material builds up on the nozzle.
This profile currently uses 250C, 80C plate and a 12 mm3/s cap - raise the nozzle toward 255C. Use Magigoo or glue stick.
